description: Figure 4 (right) illustrates how Accuracy@1 (%) on geometry problems varies with the number of child nodes (tree width) for two models. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” on a linear scale, spanning from 1 to 7 with tick marks at 1, 3, 5, and 7. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 35 with ticks at 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35. Two solid lines are shown with small circular markers: a darker blue line for GPT-4o and a lighter blue line for Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The GPT-4o line starts at 26.7% at tree width 1, rises to 28.9% at 3, increases to 34.4% at 5, then decreases to 31.1% at 7. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line starts at 24.4% at tree width 1, rises to 27.8% at 3, then declines to 24.4% at 5 and further to 20.0% at 7.
